Tree-sitter grammar notices
===========================

RepoKarta embeds parser tables for the following MIT-licensed grammars through
github.com/odvcencio/gotreesitter v0.47.0. The revisions are the exact sources
recorded by that release:

- tree-sitter-bash, a06c2e4415e9bc0346c6b86d401879ffb44058f7
  Copyright (c) 2017 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-go, 2346a3ab1bb3857b48b29d779a1ef9799a248cd7
  Copyright (c) 2014 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-groovy, a88865a3301a538e2060af5b401f4f431f71406e
  Copyright (c) 2024 Murtaza Javaid
- tree-sitter-java, e10607b45ff745f5f876bfa3e94fbcc6b44bdc11
  Copyright (c) 2017 Ayman Nadeem
- tree-sitter-javascript, 58404d8cf191d69f2674a8fd507bd5776f46cb11
  Copyright (c) 2014 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-kotlin, cbed96ab13dbc082eeeb2e8333c342a62829c29d
  Copyright (c) 2019 fwcd
- tree-sitter-python, 26855eabccb19c6abf499fbc5b8dc7cc9ab8bc64
  Copyright (c) 2016 Max Brunsfeld
- tree-sitter-sql, 587f30d184b058450be2a2330878210c5f33b3f9
  Copyright (c) 2021 Maksim Novikov
- tree-sitter-typescript (TypeScript and TSX grammars),
  75b3874edb2dc714fb1fd77a32013d0f8699989f
  Copyright (c) 2017 Max Brunsfeld
